The '''2026 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final''' was a [[hurling]] match that was played on 7 June at [[Páirc Uí Chaoimh]] in [[Cork (city)|Cork]]. It was contested by [[2025 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|defending]] champions [[Cork county hurling team|Cork]] and [[Limerick county hurling team|Limerick]].<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.gaa.ie/hurling/munster-gaa-hurling-senior-championship/cork-limerick/b1d175b3-77d2-495f-83ea-b4c5ff232855|title=  2026 Munster Hurling Final|date=29 May 2026|work=GAA.ie|accessdate=29 May 2026}}</ref>

Limerick captained by [[Cian Lynch]] won the game by one point on a 1-21 to 2-17 scoreline, it was a seventh Munster title for Limerick in eight years.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://munster.gaa.ie/event/2026-munster-senior-hurling-championship-final/|title=  2026 Munster Senior Hurling Championship Final|date=7 June 2026|work=Munster GAA|accessdate=8 June 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.rte.ie/sport/hurling/2026/0607/1577174-cork-v-limerick/|title= 2026 Munster Final: as it happened|date=7 June 2026|work=RTE Sport|accessdate=8 June 2026}}</ref>

==Pre-match==
The game was televised live on [[RTÉ 2]] as part of ''[[The Sunday Game]]'', presented by [[Joanne Cantwell]] with studio with analysis by [[Dónal Óg Cusack]], [[Liam Sheedy]], and [[Séamus Flanagan]]. Commentary on the game was provided by [[Marty Morrissey]], alongside [[Brendan Cummins (GAA player)|Brendan Cummins]].
